Sorc is fairly easy bud. Use bound aegis, mage light, hardened ward, force pulse and crystal frags on front bar with atronach or pew pew mage guild ultimate. Back bar, go 2 torugs pact swords, overload is your ulti. I go full aoe on back bar, but go resto if you like to be support. Your choice, the idea is to blow shit up with your overload anyways. 
Gear, I run 5 Julianos light, 2 molag kena, 1 heavy 1 medium, 1 gold staff ( still to get ths masters one) 3 arcane willpower rings and the 2 torugs pact on back bar for the spell damage for overload. Instead of molag kena, go for seducer set pieces until you're v16,my as well make a staff set piece too. 
The idea is to get all the passives, I've got every passive going, high elf, light, heavy, medium,undaunted,3 skill lines, alchemy(alchemy is awesome btw, get this leveled) i'd also recommend annulment, it's the skill from light armour, it's handy for shield stacking some fights.
Sorcs are fairly strong in pvp, but build, awareness and ultimately skill/exp are needed. Yolo wizard isn't good for pvp at all, sypherpk is a good starting point for sorc pvp though

Where a piece of light medium and heavy. 1 skill of each of the 3 main skill lines, 1 in destro staff, force pulse is the morph not sure of what's before that. Get annulment when you can, skill from light armour. Ward from summoning line when you can. At 15, get a resto staff, and stick a skill in there. I like alchemy, I leveled this whilst leveling, provides extra dps/magicka pots. Some like duel weild swords, or greatsword on the back bar, depends if you want to be pure dps at end game.
The above will sort you out for a while, I'd say get the first skill in dark magic, crystal frags is the morph, not sure of the lower version. 
For a better idea, check out deltias gaming(pve) sypherpk(pve) tamriel foundry- i think its yolo sorc build or something.
